plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he thinks the inventor Nikola Tesla and a later researcher named Thomas Townsend Brown both discovered the same thing. The story calls it extended electrodynamics, meaning a physics that goes beyond ordinary electricity and magnetism and often involves very high voltages across short distances. Michels says he is strongly convinced about Brown's part and believes this may be how unexplained craft fly. If he is right, those craft would run on physics people found long ago.
